en_before: Fairy Grunge leans toward fantasy, organic textures and flowing dresses or layers. Soft Goth keeps goth as its main reference, with more pronounced black, lace, mesh and gothic cues. Meanwhile, Grunge has a stronger music history and anti-fashion foundation than internet-born soft grunge. These distinctions help you choose materials and combinations deliberately.
